description: Runtime knobs. Edit freely; the routine reads these on every run.

signal_window.note: US market opens 14:30 GMT. Pre-market signals must arrive by 06:00 GMT.

macro_kill_switches.note: If VIX >= vix_max, post kill-switch message and stop. No signals regardless of individual stock setup.

confluence.note: counter_trend_min applies when weekly trend is bearish but daily is bullish (module 09).

risk.note: Stop = entry - (stop_atr_multiplier * ATR14). Target = entry + (target_atr_multiplier * ATR14). R:R must be >= min_rr.

earnings.note: post_earnings_confidence_boost: raise confluence bar by this amount on the first eligible trading day after the after-earnings blackout ends.

vix_thresholds.note: caution triggers HIGH-confidence-only mode (5/6 minimum). kill_switch fires the macro kill-switch.
